# garage_key (Data Source)

Looks up an access key by ID or by name, with the buckets it can access. The secret is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_key" "app" {
  name = "app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Access key ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the key. The lookup fails if several keys match.

### Read-Only

- `allow_create_bucket` (Boolean)
- `buckets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `created` (String)
- `expiration` (String)
- `expired` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `global_aliases` (List of String)
- `id` (String)
- `local_aliases` (List of String)
- `owner` (Boolean)
- `read` (Boolean)
- `write` (Boolean)
